title: Wrap text for the CLI help
prompt:
Implement `Wrap(text string, width int) []string` in text/wrap.go for the CLI's help output: words are separated by
any whitespace and joined with single spaces; lines are as full as possible without exceeding `width` runes; a word
longer than `width` is split into chunks of `width` runes; empty or blank text gives no lines; width < 1 panics.
Count runes, not bytes ("ção" is 3).
